method: Independent CSS Box Alignment and Grid arithmetic, compared against the pinned-profile geometry

independentReasoning.positive: The 3 grid tracks are 10px each in a definite 40px content box. start and flex-start are identical outside flex layout, so all three content-position values put the first track at the start edge and leave 10px after the final track.
independentReasoning.overflow: The definite 40px block-size basis resolves calc(120% - 2px) to a 46px row gap. Three 10px tracks plus two 46px gutters total 122px. start/flex-start places the first track at y=0 and retains the resulting 82px overflow after the content.
